name: Open Contracting Partnership
tagline: Making public contracting open, fair and efficient to benefit people and the planet.
policy_outcomes: Indirect positive impact on estimated 209 million lives and USD 116 billion of public spending (2019-2023 strategy cycle)
USD 17 billion better spent and 19 million people served in 2025
Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) adopted in 50+ countries
Brazil using open data and AI to improve USD 75 billion medicine procurement market
outcome_methodology: Annual impact reports with documented stories and systemic impact assessments; 2024-2030 strategy goals tracked publicly
documented_limitations: relies on government willingness to adopt
governance_model: Governing Board of ~10 individuals from government, private sector, civil society, and development organizations; independent 501c3 based in Washington DC
contributor_governance: Open-source standard with community contributions; staff in 50+ countries
